In qualità di tecnico di produzione certificato (m/f/d) industrializzazione, sei l'interfaccia tra sviluppo, produzione e acquisti. Valutano i componenti in termini di producibilità, costi e qualità e forniscono un contributo significativo all'industrializzazione efficiente di nuovi prodotti. Il vostro obiettivo è garantire una catena di fornitura solida utilizzando una strategia di misurazione e test adeguata, dal test iniziale del campione al rilascio in serie, in conformità con i più elevati standard militari e industriali.

descriptionByLocale.en:
What we are looking for you for

As a test planner (m/f/d) in the industrialization team, you take on a key role in ensuring the highest quality standards for safety-critical air defense components and systems. You plan, document and coordinate all test-relevant measures along the manufacturing and assembly processes. Your goal is to ensure a robust supply chain using a suitable measurement and testing strategy - from initial sample testing to series release - in compliance with the highest military and industrial standards.

Specifically, you will take on the following tasks:

- Responsibility and coordination of test planning and measurement strategy with internal and external process participants (production, measurement technology, suppliers, customer representatives, etc.)
- Analyzing and optimizing assemblies and individual parts with regard to testability and measurability, measurement repeatability and the optimal type of process control (e.g. in-line, goods receipt, at the supplier)
- Creation and revision of test plans, drawings and instructions with corresponding data maintenance in SAP in the MM & QM modules
- Supporting the organization through corrective and preventive quality assurance measures such as the selection of suitable testing and measuring equipment, initial sampling and initial sample test reports, root cause analyses, dealing with NCR, audits, etc.

What to bring with you

- Completed technical training with further training as a technician (m/f/d) or completed studies in the field of mechanical engineering, mechatronics, aerospace engineering or comparable
- Several years of experience in test planning in an industrial environment, ideally in the defense, aviation or high-tech industries
- Knowledge of creating test plans and test programs for mechanical, electrical and electronic components
- Confident handling of technical drawings, tolerances and measuring systems (3D measurement technology is an advantage)
- Knowledge of relevant standards: EN 9100, AQAP 2110, MIL-STD, STANAG
- Experience working with CAQ, ERP and PLM systems
- Good knowledge of German and English, both spoken and written
- Security check Ü1/Ü2 (or willingness to carry out)

- A dynamic working environment with exciting projects
- Flexible working hours (flexitime and trust working hours)
- Very good social benefits and a non-mandatory pension fund

- Soutenir l'organisation par des mesures d'assurance qualité correctives et préventives telles que la sélection d'équipements de test et de mesure appropriés, les rapports d'échantillonnage initial et de test d'échantillon initial, les analyses des causes profondes, le traitement des NCR, les audits, etc.
